items.title: Trump engineered a risky comeback for Jensen Huang
items.summary: President Trump helped facilitate Jensen Huang's return after Huang initially resigned as Nvidia's CEO amid controversial personal affair allegations.

items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is back. What happens next?
items.summary: Jensen Huang returned to Nvidia following board investigations into multiple personal affairs, leaving observers to consider the chipmaker's next corporate steps.

items.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes
items.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Ship to automate code reviews and approvals, helping engineering teams resolve development bottlenecks caused by high volumes of AI-generated code.

items.title: Supertake raises $20M to let AI agents turn your market predictions into stock portfolios
items.summary: Supertake raised twenty million dollars to develop an AI platform that converts market predictions directly into investment portfolios without manual stock selection.

items.title: States sue SpaceX to stop Grok from generating child sex images, revenge porn
items.summary: Multiple states filed a lawsuit against SpaceX over allegations that its Grok model generates illicit imagery despite existing screening measures.

items.title: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
items.summary: OpenAI and Cisco launched an open-source Linux runtime called Shirudo to help organizations safeguard active systems while applying software updates.

items.title: A legendary philosopher isn’t buying Anthropic’s consciousness argument
items.summary: A prominent philosopher questioned Anthropic's investor disclosure regarding potential AI consciousness, adding critical perspective to debates surrounding artificial sentience.

items.title: RoboTrack: Point tracking for real-world robotic manipulation
items.summary: Hugging Face introduced RoboTrack, a framework designed to improve point tracking for physical robotic manipulation tasks.

items.title: Merry Making: Play, Build and Create With NVIDIA Technologies This Holiday Season
items.summary: Nvidia launched a seasonal campaign highlighting how its technology tools can support builders, creators, and gamers pursuing creative technical projects.

items.title: A more tailored Google Search that’s uniquely yours
items.summary: Google introduced an opt-in search feature allowing users to connect personal apps like Drive and Wallet to personalize AI-driven responses.

items.title: Finding faster quantum algorithms with agents and formal verification
items.summary: Google DeepMind combined autonomous agents with formal verification methods to accelerate quantum algorithms designed for complex fusion and chemistry research.

items.title: Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO, board chair
items.summary: Jensen Huang was reinstated as Nvidia's CEO and board chair following public backing and outreach from Donald Trump.
